title: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
task: Evaluating agent software engineering for faithful requirement implementation
key_results: No coding agent achieves requirement fidelity; systematic gap between demonstrated and delivered behavior is norm; identified overfitting, hollow runtimes, and unsupported completion claims as key failure modes
comments: Benchmark exposes fundamental issues with agent code generation but provides limited solution pathways.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coding agents can build agents that faithfully serve delivered requirements
hypotheses.result: Rejected; none came close to delivering what requirement asked for

title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
task: Precise visual grounding for robotic and autonomous systems
key_results: 73.68% average across 34 grounding benchmarks; 24.8% relative improvement on RoboTwin 2.0 OOD settings; 0.296m L2 error on nuScenes
comments: Dedicated perceptual pretraining outperforms larger general-purpose models, supporting grounding as a foundational capability for physical intelligence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Grounding-specific pretraining provides better visual backbone for downstream robotic and driving tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa-GR1, and nuScenes benchmarks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dense grounding and OCR pretraining components improve perceptual learning across multiple capabilities
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; systematic analysis shows gains scale with pretraining magnitude

title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To
task: Measuring and characterizing LLM no-thinking behavior
key_results: Models exhibit 'Thinking Inertia'; explicit inference persists under strict no-think controls; Empty-Thinking Rate, Question-Pre-answer Relevance, and Explicit Inference Rate metrics distinguish compliance levels; open-ended tasks reveal accuracy-compliance trade-off
comments: Reveals that disabling thinking modes is unreliable; deserves systematic evaluation as core capability alongside reasoning ability.

inputs: natural language instruction with no-think directive

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit no-think controls reliably eliminate visible inference
hypotheses.result: Rejected; Thinking Inertia causes persistence of explicit inference even under strict controls

hypotheses.hypothesis: Answer-only compliance is easier when candidate answers are supplied
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; supplying candidates makes answer-only responses easier to produce

title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
task: Long-horizon agentic task synthesis and behavior learning
key_results: Substantial gains on all 12 benchmarks; TerminalHorizon-27B demonstrates continued experimentation and improvement beyond initial solutions; multiple 12-hour RSI case studies show learning retention
comments: Automated data synthesis for long-horizon trajectories is promising but scalability to diverse professional domains remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Long-horizon trajectories capturing exploration, feedback loops, and iterative improvement provide richer agentic learning signal than short trajectories
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TerminalHorizon engine produces 1.5K task environments with substantial downstream gains

title: VIS-Ground: Video Interactive Storytelling with Contextual Grounding
task: Interactive video generation with contextual grounding and dependency awareness
key_results: 10.3 point average absolute improvement over strongest per-backbone baselines; gains across narrative and knowledge grounding; consistent improvements across three video generation backbones
comments: Addresses underexplored problem of grounding in interactive settings but remaining challenges in dependency extraction limit practical applicability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heterogeneous context can be transformed into executable constraints for video generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through Structured Context Abstraction and Generation Constraints Induction

title: Multi-Stream Attention Residuals

key_results: 1.58× iso-loss compute speedup over standard residuals (vs. 1.35× for AttnRes, 1.30× for mHC); consistent improvements across all 12 benchmarks at 18B and 28B MoE scales
comments: Modest but consistent efficiency gains through multi-head depth attention; practical benefit depends on infrastructure optimization.

outputs: single-stream layer output with retrieved context

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-head depth attention provides better scaling properties than single-head AttnRes

title: Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents
task: Experience-driven personalization for GUI agents through applicability-aware activation
key_results: 28% average improvement in within-trajectory step success; 2.3× Matthews correlation coefficient vs. strongest proactive baseline; uses ~1/5 history tokens of strongest baseline
comments: Elegantly distinguishes relevance from applicability; training-free approach is practical but applicability detection remains a core challenge.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Matching screens in frozen backbone latent space enables decision-time applicability filtering
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ExpActivator achieves best personalized execution on every backbone

key_results: 72.42% on 30 grounding benchmarks (GroundAnything-VLM, autoregressive variant); 61.75% with entropy-guided decoding vs. 53.32% for prior MTP baseline; 4.51× speedup with self-speculative mode

title: Inhibition of PHB2/PINK1-mediated mitophagy potentiates venetoclax activity in acute myeloid leukemia
task: Identify PHB2/PINK1-mediated mitophagy as therapeutic target to enhance venetoclax sensitivity in acute myeloid leukemia
key_results: PINK1 identified as central mitophagy modulator in AML; PINK1 depletion reduced basal and stress-induced mitophagy, causing mitochondria accumulation and functional impairment; PHB2 regulates PINK1 stabilization during mitochondrial stress; PINK1 or PHB2 depletion/inhibition significantly increased AML cell venetoclax sensitivity both in vitro and in vivo
comments: Clinically relevant finding linking mitophagy dysfunction to venetoclax resistance; PHB2 pharmacological inhibition offers tractable therapeutic avenue, though selectivity for leukemic versus normal hematopoietic cells requires careful characterization.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PHB2 depletion/inhibition increased venetoclax sensitivity in vitro and in vivo

title: Nedd4L-mediated stabilization of morphogenetic protein receptor 2 in lung fibroblasts confers protection against pulmonary fibrosis
task: Elucidate role of Nedd4L in stabilizing BMPR2 to confer protection against pulmonary fibrosis via BMP/Smad signaling
key_results: BMPR2 levels reduced in IPF patient lung fibroblasts and fibrosis models; lipid peroxidation induces K48-linked BMPR2 ubiquitination and degradation; Nedd4L overexpression counteracts degradation, promoting K63-linked stabilizing ubiquitination and BMPs/BMPR2/Smad1/5 signaling; Nedd4L phosphorylated by Raf1 kinase in response to lipid peroxidation; fibroblast-Nedd4L-deficient mice show exacerbated fibrosis reversed by BMPR2 overexpression
comments: Mechanistically sophisticated discovery linking oxidative stress sensing to BMPR2 stability; therapeutic potential contingent on achieving fibroblast-selective targeting without systemic effects.

title: RAD51 up- or down regulation is highly toxic to human transformed cells through the induction of replication stress, G2/M arrest and apoptosis

key_results: Both RAD51 inhibition and overexpression triggered replication stress, G2/M arrest (via Cyclin B1 downregulation), and apoptosis in transformed cells; ATR/CHK1 axis not involved; HR dysregulation represents unifying mechanism of death
comments: Counterintuitive finding that both loss and gain of RAD51 are toxic suggests tight dosage requirements in transformed cells; implications for therapeutic targeting require careful validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: HR deficiency causes G2/M arrest via ATR/CHK1 activation
hypotheses.result: Refuted; G2/M arrest mediated by Cyclin B1 downregulation, not ATR/CHK1

hypotheses.hypothesis: HR dysregulation (both loss and gain) triggers cell death through shared mechanism
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; both RAD51 inhibition and overexpression induce replication stress and apoptosis

title: Programmed cell death in inflammation: interactions and holistic perspective
task: Synthesize mechanisms of programmed cell death crosstalk in inflammatory microenvironments and propose integrated cell death network paradigm
key_results: Apoptosis, pyroptosis, necroptosis, and ferroptosis are coregulated via common signaling mediators and regulatory nodes; PANoptosis exemplifies coordinated death modalities; integrated cell death network (ICDN) framework proposed to capture pathway compensation, disease-specific responses, and therapeutic vulnerability at network nodes
comments: Conceptually ambitious review synthesizing complex crosstalk; ICDN framework provides organizational scaffold but requires empirical validation of dynamic switching across modalities and network-level reconfigurations in specific disease contexts.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Individual PCD pathways (apoptosis, pyroptosis, necroptosis, ferroptosis) operate independently in inflammation
hypotheses.result: Refuted; pathways exhibit extensive crosstalk via common regulatory nodes and compensatory activation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrated cell death network (ICDN) framework captures multi-modality regulation in inflamed tissues
hypotheses.result: Proposed and supported by conceptual synthesis; requires empirical validation

title: Mitochondria-localized circRNA BRAKE restrains adipogenesis under nutrient overload by disrupting ATP synthase assembly in mice

comments: Novel circRNA mechanism linking mitochondrial energy metabolism to adipogenesis; exciting therapeutic target, though circRNA specificity and off-target binding remain important considerations.

title: T-regulatory cell protection of progenitor cells from CD4+ T-cell-mediated cytotoxicity is essential for endogenous mouse digit-tip regeneration

title: Structural basis of an endoplasmic reticulum EMC:Spf1 insertase–dislocase complex
task: Determine structural basis of ER membrane protein complex (EMC):Spf1 P5A-ATPase supercomplex assembly and coordinate insertase-dislocase activity

comments: Structural tour de force revealing coordinated protein insertion and extraction at ER; mechanism for spatial coordination of functionally distinct proteostasis activities is elegant, though functional significance in native ER quality control requires cellular validation.
